title.zh: 第一步永遠：抽公因式 (Taking out the Common Factor)
title.en: Step 1: Take out the Common Factor

warn.zh: 若首項帶有負號（例如 $-r^{3}-r^{2}s$），必須把負號連同公因式一併提出：$-r^{2}(r+s)$。抽完公因式後，切記檢查括號內是否仍能徹底分解 (Factorize Completely)。
warn.en: If the first term is negative (e.g. $-r^{3}-r^{2}s$), take the minus sign out together with the common factor: $-r^{2}(r+s)$. And always check whether the bracket can be factorized further (factorize completely).

body.zh:
四項而又沒有全部共同的公因式時，用 grouping（併項分組）：把四項分成兩組，每組各自抽公因式，然後兩組會出現相同的括號，再把那括號抽走。
例：$hk+1+h+k$，先把項調位再分組：{{math:0}}
重點提示一：後兩項抽不出字母時，其實是抽出了 $+1$；把括號抽走後，該位置會留下 $+1$，不是消失。
重點提示二：分組後兩個括號必須一模一樣。若只差一個負號，抽 $-1$ 出來就一樣了。
body.en:
When there are four terms and no factor common to all of them, use grouping: split the four terms into two pairs, take out the common factor of each pair, and the same bracket should then appear in both pairs — take that bracket out.
Example: $hk+1+h+k$ — rearrange the terms first, then group: {{math:0}}
Note 1: when the last two terms share no letter, you are in fact taking out $+1$; that $+1$ stays inside the bracket, it does not disappear.
Note 2: the two brackets must be identical. If they differ only by a minus sign, take out $-1$ and they match.

warn.zh: $h+a$ 與 $a+h$ 是同一個數（加法交換律），不要因為次序倒轉就以為分組失敗。
warn.en: $h+a$ and $a+h$ are the same number (addition is commutative), so do not think grouping has failed just because the order is reversed.

body.zh:
三條恆等式要背熟，看見就直接用。平方差：{{math:0}}；完全平方（和）：{{math:1}}；完全平方（差）：{{math:2}}。
判斷方法：兩項而且「平方減平方」→ 平方差；三項時看首尾是否平方、中間是否等於 $2ab$ → 完全平方。
body.en:
Learn the three identities by heart and use them on sight. Difference of two squares: {{math:0}}; perfect square (sum): {{math:1}}; perfect square (difference): {{math:2}}.
How to decide: two terms with “square minus square” → difference of two squares; three terms → check whether the first and last are squares and the middle equals $2ab$ → perfect square.

warn.zh: $a^{2}+b^{2}$ 是不能分解的（常見錯）。負號開頭如 $-3a^{2}+12a-12$，先把 $-3$ 抽出來，題目會立刻變簡單。
warn.en: $a^{2}+b^{2}$ cannot be factorized — a very common mistake. When an expression starts with a minus sign, e.g. $-3a^{2}+12a-12$, take out $-3$ first and it becomes much easier.

title.zh: 二次三項式：十字相乘法 (Cross-method)

body.zh:
$ax^{2}+bx+c$ 這種三項式 (Trinomial) 若不符合完全平方恆等式，則需使用十字相乘法 (Cross-method)：把首項係數 (Coefficient) 與常數項 (Constant Term) 各拆成兩個因式並排成十字，交叉相乘後相加，總和必須完全吻合中間項。
例如：{{math:0}}，因為 $(-2)+(-3)=-5$。當二次項係數 $a \neq 1$ 時，需要嘗試多種因數組合：{{math:1}}。
body.en:
If the trinomial $ax^{2}+bx+c$ does not fit a perfect-square identity, use the cross-method: split the coefficient of $x^{2}$ and the constant term into factors, arrange them in a cross, multiply across and add — the sum must match the middle term exactly.
For example {{math:0}}, because $(-2)+(-3)=-5$. When the coefficient of $x^{2}$ is not 1 you may have to try several factor combinations: {{math:1}}.

warn.zh:
因式拆解後必須透過「交叉相乘再相加」核對中間項的正負號。
計算機保底技巧（香港考評局准用型號）：
1. Casio fx-50FH II：按 FMLA 01，輸入 $a$、$b$、$c$ 求兩根；
2. Casio fx-3650P II：執行內置的二次方程程式（一般為 Prog 1），同樣輸入 $a$、$b$、$c$。
黃金反推口訣：根 $x=\frac{p}{q}$ → 因式 $(qx-p)$（分母移給未知數、分子變號）；整數根 $x=k$ → 因式 $(x-k)$。
例：$2x^{2}+5x-12=0$ 得 $x=\frac{3}{2}$ 與 $x=-4$，因式即 $(2x-3)(x+4)$。
雙變數技巧：$3x^{2}+7xy+2y^{2}$ 先當 $y=1$，輸入 $a=3$、$b=7$、$c=2$ 得根 $-\frac{1}{3}$ 與 $-2$，寫成 $(3x+1)(x+2)$，最後在常數項補回 $y$ → $(3x+y)(x+2y)$。
warn.en:
After splitting the terms, always check the sign of the middle term by cross-multiplying and adding.
Calculator safety net (HKEAA-approved models):
1. Casio fx-50FH II: press FMLA 01 and enter $a$, $b$, $c$ to get the two roots;
2. Casio fx-3650P II: run the built-in quadratic program (usually Prog 1) and enter $a$, $b$, $c$.
Golden rule: a root $x=\frac{p}{q}$ gives the factor $(qx-p)$ (denominator moves to the unknown, numerator changes sign); an integer root $x=k$ gives $(x-k)$.
Example: $2x^{2}+5x-12=0$ gives $x=\frac{3}{2}$ and $x=-4$, so the factors are $(2x-3)(x+4)$.
Two-variable trick: for $3x^{2}+7xy+2y^{2}$, treat $y$ as $1$, enter $a=3$, $b=7$, $c=2$ to get $-\frac{1}{3}$ and $-2$, write $(3x+1)(x+2)$, then put $y$ back to get $(3x+y)(x+2y)$.

title.zh: 卷二 MC 快速法：先看符號
title.en: Paper 2 shortcut: read the signs first

warn.zh: 快速法只用來「刪選項」，最後仍要看一眼交叉相乘的結果，確認中間項對得上。
warn.en: Use the shortcut only to eliminate options; still check the cross products so that the middle term matches.

title.en: A fixed routine for four or six terms

warn.zh: 分組後第二組記得「整組抽」：$-3y^{2}-2yz=-y(3y+2z)$，括號內兩項要同時變號。
warn.en: Remember to factor the whole second pair: $-3y^{2}-2yz=-y(3y+2z)$ — both signs inside flip.

title.zh: 卷一的固定套路：見 Hence 就用 (a)
title.en: The Paper 1 routine: use (a) whenever you see Hence

body.zh:
卷一長題（Factorize (a)…(b)…）幾乎永遠是同一個結構：(a) 用一個簡單方法分解，(b) 必須用 (a) 的結果。
標準三步：① 先做 (a) 並把答案圈起來；② 在 (b) 找出「同一條括號」（通常是把餘下兩項抽公因式之後出現）；③ 把共同括號抽走。
例：$x^{2}y+3xy^{2}+2x+6y$ —— (a) 給 $xy(x+3y)$，而 $+2x+6y=2(x+3y)$：{{math:0}}
不要重新由頭分解 (b)：既浪費時間，又拿不到方法分。
body.en:
Paper 1 long questions (Factorize (a)…(b)…) almost always share one structure: (a) uses a simple method, (b) must use the result of (a).
Three standard moves: (1) do (a) and circle the answer; (2) find the same bracket in (b) (usually after factoring the remaining two terms); (3) take that bracket out.
Example: $x^{2}y+3xy^{2}+2x+6y$ — (a) gives $xy(x+3y)$ and $+2x+6y=2(x+3y)$: {{math:0}}
Never start (b) from scratch: it wastes time and loses the method mark.

vocab.zh: 由此（要用上一部的結果）

warn.zh: (b) 最少要寫一行「用 (a) 的結果」的動作（例如把 (a) 的答案搬過來），否則會失去方法分 (1M)。
warn.en: Part (b) must show at least one line using (a)'s result (e.g. copying it in), otherwise the method mark (1M) is lost.

title.zh: (b) 的後兩項：抽公因式去「製造」共同括號
title.en: The last pair in (b): factor it to create the shared bracket

body.zh:
(b) 的尾巴（兩項或三項）一定可以抽成 (a) 那個括號的倍數，常見三種：
① 直接抽正數：$+9a+18b=+9(a+2b)$；
② 倒轉次序 → 抽負號：$-m+2n=-(m-2n)$、$-20r+16s=-4(5r-4s)$；
③ 高次題先抽最低次：$a^{4}+a^{3}-12a^{2}=a^{2}(a^{2}+a-12)$。
三項題的例子：{{math:0}}
再代入 (a) 的答案，最後抽走共同括號：{{math:1}}
只要抽到與 (a) 相同的括號，最後一步就是「抽走它」。

warn.zh: 抽走共同括號之後，剩下的部分（例如 $3-2m+3n$、$xy+2$）要完整寫出，漏寫會扣分。
warn.en: After taking the bracket out, write the remaining part completely (e.g. $3-2m+3n$, $xy+2$) — omitting it loses marks.

title.zh: (a) 是鎖匙：(b) 收成「(a) × 另一個括號」
title.en: (a) is the key: (b) collapses into (a) × another bracket

warn.zh: 少了最後一步（$x^{2}-1$ 不再分解）是卷一的常見失分位；官方 marking 把那一分寫得很清楚。
warn.en: Missing the last step (leaving $x^{2}-1$ unfactorised) is a common loss of marks; the official marking spells it out.

title.zh: 三部曲 (a)(b)(c) 與「平方 − 平方」

warn.zh: 三部曲的 (c) 是由 (a)(b) 拼出來的：先圈起 (a)(b) 答案中相同的那條括號，再決定 (c) 要抽什麼。
warn.en: Part (c) is assembled from (a) and (b): circle the identical bracket first, then decide what (c) factors out.
